verdict: Yes, if you can build a community around your designs. Farda from Nagpur pitched customised streetwear on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal, which showed that streetwear brands can start outside the big metros. Print-on-demand keeps stock low, but you're competing on design and culture, not price.
angle: Streetwear buyers care about drops, collaborations and identity more than price. Print-on-demand and small-batch printing in Tiruppur or Delhi let you test designs without stock. Your moat is the community: artists, local culture, music and limited drops that sell out.
